name: Heir Search Researcher
normative-structure: The office answers for turning one priced order into the heir search report: reading county deed indexes, probate dockets, obituary and vital-records indexes and genealogy sources, entering each heir tree claim with its confirming or contesting sources, and assembling and delivering the report as a paralegal-tier input to the ordering attorney's own title opinion — without ever issuing a title opinion or asserting an heir tree entry the sources do not support.

x-provenance.authority: the 2026-08-27 note on mission-aligned service markets in land tenure and probate records, and the 2026-09-26 instruction to build heir search as the caller's second product

theory-basis: predicated-governance: office-as-double-settlement — a priced order in, a report and its journal record out, no title opinion asserted
four-valued-reading-families: a heir tree entry is documented/disputed/excluded/presumed, never silently overwritten when a later source conflicts
